_comment: compound_scenario plus a new regime -- 533 jobs across 17 phases, ~15855s total: quiet -> bottleneck -> quiet -> standoff -> quiet -> speed_trap -> quiet -> burst -> quiet -> starvation -> quiet -> bottleneck (repeat) -> quiet -> standoff (repeat) -> quiet -> speed_trap (repeat) -> quiet_cooldown. speed_trap is the first tested regime where SPT_SMPT (the rule that otherwise wins or ties almost everywhere in compound_scenario) loses decisively to SRWT-family routing -- see speed_trap_standoff()/_speed_trap_phase_jobs for the mechanism. See _phases for exact start/end/n_jobs per phase.
name: compound_scenario_v2
